title: campanula formanekiana
intro: Campanula formanekiana, commonly known as Fratercula, is a perennial plant species native to the Balkan Peninsula. As a medicinal plant, it has been used in traditional folk medicine to treat various health conditions. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Campanula formanekiana include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, making it a valuable resource in natural medicine.
